notes: CR: large financial data corp exploring RAG for internal research + client-facing insights. Primary pain: scale (500M-1B vectors), predictable unit economics, and low p95 latency for reranking pipeline. Key quotes: "need under $0.003/query at 200 qps sustained" and "cannot ship without VPC + audit logs + KMS". Initial discovery: product team cares about reranker + embed combo (two-stage: approximate nearest neighbor -> lightweight reranker). Security team: strict residency + SOC2 + per-route audit logs. POC summary: ingest backfill test (200M documents) planned; initial backfill will be ~250M vectors, ongoing delta 5M vectors/day. POC results so far: batched ingestion with RDW suggested config hit 9.5M vectors/hour (single shard) — needs horizontalization. Reranker tested (small transformer) increases p95 by ~60-90ms; current end-to-end p95 for top-k=10 pipeline ~180-220ms in lab. Cost sensitivity: looking to optimize quantized embeddings + batching + cache to get cost down to <$0.0025/query. Ops requirements: incremental deletes, consistency SLA for business-critical indices, ability to pin model versions and fallback to cheaper model under load. Notes from call: AE introduced Dedicated + Optimize; SE walked through batching knobs and cache TTLs. Security call 2026-03-02: asked for explicit audit log format and encryption-at-rest confirmation. Sales asks: quote for Dedicated pool (8x A100 equiv) + on-prem connector. EU region proof-of-residency required for certain clients. Next deliverables: POC latency run with reranker in-canary, security questionnaire answers, draft TCV and OLA for ingestion SLA.
